label: Wait
description: Pauses the workflow for a while, until a time, or until an event arrives (with a time limit), then continues on its own. Nothing runs while it waits, and the wait survives restarts.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go once the wait is over: connect the next step, or Finish.

mode.title: Wait
mode.description: For a while: a duration from when the run gets here. Until a time: a date and time. Until an event: an event sent to the project, or the time limit, whichever comes first.

duration.title: How long
duration.description: e.g. 3d, 2h 30m, 90 minutes or PT45M; or a template such as {{ state.delay }}. Up to a year.

until.title: Until
until.description: e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00 (in the time zone below) or 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z; or a template such as {{ state.follow_up_at }}. A time already past does not wait.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: For a time without an offset, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Empty: UTC.

event.title: Event
event.description: The event type that ends the wait, e.g. invoice.paid. Send it to the project's events (POST /v1/projects/{project}/events).

event_key.title: Only the event with this key
event_key.description: e.g. {{ state.invoice_id }}: only an event whose data has this "key" ends the wait. Empty: any event of that type ends every run waiting for it.

timeout.title: Time limit
timeout.description: How long to wait for the event, e.g. 3d. When it runs out, the run continues with timed_out true.

output.title: Save what ended the wait in
output.description: Optional. The data field that receives {timed_out, event, woke_at}: route on state.<field>.timed_out after it.
